title: Road 2 Web Summit 2026 já aceita candidaturas de startups portuguesas para mais uma edição
what_it_says: Reports applications open for the eleventh edition: up to 125 companies, bootcamp in Porto and Lisbon, 50% off ALPHA or BETA, extra space on Portugal's stand, Galp's prizes, last year's winners with their sectors, 1,200 startups since 2016 and three PITCH winners in five editions.
